operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Updates an existing journal entry and replaces its line items.

**Amounts.** Send the line amounts as `currency_debit` / `currency_credit`, in the journal's currency. The base-currency `debit` / `credit` fields are derived by the server (`currency_* x currency_rate`) and anything sent in them is overwritten - a payload that carries only `debit` / `credit` has every line discarded and is rejected with `400`.

**Line items are a full replacement.** The `JournalTransaction` array is the complete set: a line with `id` updates that line, a line without `id` is inserted, and any existing line missing from the array is deleted. A line `id` that belongs to a different journal is rejected with `400`.

**Balance.** The sum of `currency_debit` must equal the sum of `currency_credit`; `total_debit` and `total_credit` on the journal are recomputed from the lines and cannot be set directly.

The `{id}` in the URL identifies the journal. `Journal.id` in the body is optional, but when present it must match the URL id.

id.description: Journal REF #. Optional - the `{id}` in the URL is authoritative. If you do send it, it must equal the URL id, otherwise the request is rejected with `400`.

date.description: Journal date. Must fall inside an open financial period, otherwise the request is rejected. Omit to keep the current date.

currency_code.description: Currency of the entry. **Always send it** - every line item's `currency_code` is overwritten with this value, so omitting it blanks the currency on all lines.

manual_currency_rate.description: Explicit FX rate from `currency_code` to the site's base currency. Omit (or send `null`) to let the server resolve the rate for `date`. Do **not** send `0` or `""`.

alter_description.description: Overridden description, used for auto-generated journals. Ignored when it equals `description`.

number.description: Journal number. Auto-generated; send it only to override.

attachment.description: Comma-separated file ids to keep attached. **Omitting it detaches the journal's existing attachments**, so send the current ids when you do not intend to change them.

total_debit.description: **Read only** - recomputed from the line items on every save. Anything sent here is ignored.

total_credit.description: **Read only** - recomputed from the line items on every save. Anything sent here is ignored.

currency_debit.description: **Read only** - total debit in the journal's currency, recomputed from the line items.

currency_credit.description: **Read only** - total credit in the journal's currency, recomputed from the line items.

staff_id.description: **Read only on edit** - the creating staff is preserved.

entity_type.description: **Read only** - set only for auto-generated journals.

entity_id.description: **Read only** - set only for auto-generated journals.

is_automatic.description: **Read only** - `1` when the journal was generated from another transaction.

created.description: Time of creation for the journal

modified.description: Last time this journal was updated

JournalTransaction.description: The **complete** set of line items for this journal. This array replaces the existing set: a line carrying `id` is updated, a line without `id` is inserted, and **any existing line whose id is absent from the array is deleted**. At least two lines are required, and the sum of `currency_debit` must equal the sum of `currency_credit` (tolerance 0.001) or the request is rejected with `400`.

id.description: Existing journal transaction REF #. Send it to **update** that line; omit it to **insert** a new line. The id must belong to this journal - a line id from another journal is rejected with `400`.

journal_account_id.description: Journal Account REF # to post this line to. Get it from [GET Journal Accounts](/15115326e0). A line with no `journal_account_id` is discarded.

currency_debit.description: Debit amount **in the journal's currency**. This is the field the API reads for the debit side - not `debit`. Send `0` for a credit line.

currency_credit.description: Credit amount **in the journal's currency**. This is the field the API reads for the credit side - not `credit`. Send `0` for a debit line.

alter_description.description: Overridden description, used for auto-generated journals. Ignored when it equals `description`.

tax_id.description: Tax applied to this line. Get it from [GET Taxes](/15115346e0). When set, the server splits the amount and generates an additional tax line for you.

debit.description: Debit amount in the site's base currency. **Read only - derived as `currency_debit * currency_rate`.** Anything sent here is overwritten.

credit.description: Credit amount in the site's base currency. **Read only - derived as `currency_credit * currency_rate`.** Anything sent here is overwritten.

currency_code.description: Currency Code. Read only in practice - every line is forced to `Journal.currency_code`.

currency_rate.description: FX rate used for this line. **Read only** - resolved by the server from `Journal.date`, or from `Journal.manual_currency_rate` when supplied.

subkey.description: Transaction sub-key. **Read only** - set by the server for auto-generated lines (taxes, client/supplier postings).

journal_id.description: Journal REF #. **Read only** - taken from the journal being edited.

created.description: Time of creation for this transaction

modified.description: Last time this transaction was updated
